title: v0.21.3 — Remove Steering, Fix GSD Prompt Architecture
description:
Remove ALL steering, budgets, and nudging from the GSD workflow. Fix the exploring prompt to enforce a strict single-pass read-once-write-immediately workflow. Remove dead test files. Version bump to 0.21.3.

Core principle: The GSD prompt must be self-correcting by design. No runtime guards, no budgets, no steering messages. The LLM reads once, plans immediately, writes wave docs.

Waves:
- W0: Remove steering system entirely (steering.rkt, gsd-read-tracker, iteration.rkt intent/stall injection)
- W1: Rewrite exploring prompt — single-pass, write-immediately
- W2: Remove budget enforcement from tool guard + clean state
- W3: Remove dead test files, clean up, version bump

title: v0.22.3 — CI Pipeline Hardening
description:
Fix CI failures and fundamentally improve CI integration into milestone workflow.

Key changes:
1. Fix wave_finish docs-sync bug (missing cwd=Q_DIR)
2. Consolidate CI jobs — eliminate redundant lint steps
3. Add PR fast-feedback gate (lint-only job)
4. Add sync-version.rkt --write --all to handle docs/ files
5. Make bump-version.rkt handle full docs sync in one step
6. Ensure version bumps are atomic (no drift possible)
